exactInputSingle((address,address,uint24.notice: Executes a single-hop swap using USDC base units per whole XAUT.         Token amounts are normalized by xautScale, then discounted by swapFeeBps.

fundPool(uint256,uint256).notice: Fund the pool with tokens so swaps can execute.         Pulls tokens from msg.sender via transferFrom.         NOTE: on Arc Testnet the USDC predeploy's delegatecall proxy can cause a         StackUnderflow when called from a Foundry broadcast script. Use         fundPoolDirect() instead when deploying via forge script.

fundPoolDirect(uint256,uint256).notice: Fund the pool by accepting tokens already transferred to this contract.         Caller must send tokens directly (transfer, not approve+transferFrom) before         calling this function. This avoids triggering the Arc Testnet USDC predeploy's         delegatecall stack depth issue in Foundry broadcast scripts.         The function verifies the pool actually holds at least the declared amounts.

setPrice(uint256).notice: Set the pool price. Used in tests to simulate price movement and deviation.

setTokenOrder(bool).notice: Configure either real token ordering and preserve the quoted whole-token price.

sqrtPriceX96().notice: sqrtPriceX96 consistent with usdcPerXaut. Stored as uint160.

swapFeeBps().notice: Slippage applied to swaps: output = input * ratio / 10_000 (default 9980 = 0.2% fee sim).

usdcPerXaut().notice: Pool price in USDC-per-XAUT, both in their native decimals (e.g. 3_300_000_000 = $3300 at 6 dec each).
